scope: R6-004 v3 artifact review. The three v2 corrections hold; the outer complete-checkpoint gate still omits provenance cross-bindings. No native episode, adapter or Lean replay rerun.

independent_recomputation.scope: Independent Git-object, byte-hash, event-chain and suite recomputation; no native execution.

recount_before_review_files_added.scope: artifact recomputation and a complete publication-bundle scan after the native suite; no additional execution, credential experiment, TLS, remote receipt, compilation or inference attestation
recount_before_review_files_added.disclosure_population_note: the reflected control deliberately retains its synthetic canary as research evidence; the bundle is not clean, and no blanket zero is claimed for it

gate_suite.scope: validated at publication; the probes call recount against a checkpoint that predates their own results, so recount cannot validate this suite

remaining_contract_gap.checkpoint_identity: policy_sha256 and source_lock_sha256 are not compared to frozen policy/lock
remaining_contract_gap.native_record: seal_sha256, files_scanned, coverage, disclosures and outer_log_clean are not cross-checked; only four predicates are
remaining_contract_gap.preservation_population: The supplied prior-artifacts map is checked against the tree without checking its membership/values against the pinned Git inventory; an empty map passes

scope_qualification: The submitted artifacts themselves agree under independent recomputation; the accepted mutations expose omitted outer-audit relationships. They do not demonstrate an invalid proof or disclosure in an accepted episode.
